description.html: An artificial plant does not wilt, needs no lighting or fertilizer and does not affect water parameters, so it is a good choice for beginners and for aquariums with fish that nibble or uproot live plants. It gives smaller fish, fry and shrimp cover and a place to rest.
The photo is for illustration only: shape and color depend on current stock, so call us and we will send you photos of the models available. If you need a different height, we also have 20 cm plants.

At 10 cm high, it is a foreground plant: place it in front of taller plants and decorations, along the glass or around stones, or use it in small aquariums where tall plants would not fit. During regular maintenance, take the plant out and rinse it with lukewarm water, removing algae with a soft brush and no detergents. Rinse it before putting it in the aquarium for the first time as well. Browse our other decorations and equipment.

Order by phone or WhatsApp message. Fast courier delivery. Customers in Novi Sad can pick up their order directly at our workshop. Contact us with any questions about the product or for a recommendation for your species.
